profile: shared AMD EPYC 9554; 64 threads; portable, shared RHS; frozen source 7dee3a3a
cost_contract: Completed runs are cost-eligible only when all three totals meet their predeclared cap. Caps came from historical ed63b8bc references; they are not a matched ratio reference for these runs.
notes: Absolute descriptive costs only. Do not infer apxchol speedup ratios or compare the two allocations as matched variants.
Over-cap costs stay blank, even when a numerically correct solution was obtained. Unsupported and timeout outcomes remain visible.
A missing cost or residual is not a successful zero-cost result.
Each variant used one shared 64-thread allocation with boost enabled, on different nodes (eu-g6-038 portable; eu-g6-032 MKL). Cross-node variant comparisons are descriptive only.
Native saved-vector grades were reviewed; vector bytes remain remote and were not replayed locally. Inclusive preparation costs that add graph serialization are not projected here.

The predeclared cap classifies portable grid3d_250 as exceeded_cap: worst repeat 129.171317 s versus 128.44994 s (0.56% over). This cap uses an exclusive-profile reference; a shared-only reference would admit that cell. The original classification is retained.

Timeout cap_s fields are blank. These cells used cap-derived deadlines; as-Skitter had a 30 s cap, a 330 s slot and a 1650 s logical-cell limit. com-Orkut had a 380.034 s cap, a 680 s slot and a 3400 s logical-cell limit. Blank cap_s does not imply an uncapped run.
